header: One call to a Claude model (Anthropic Messages API). I kept it in the shape geminiGenerate already speaks: the same request (system, prompt, temperature, token budget, timeout) and the same reply ({ text, model, usage, finishReason }). geminiGenerate (src/lib/ai/geminiChat.ts) sends a model whose name starts with "claude" here and any other name to Gemini. So I change a briefing's writer or checker to Claude just by NAMING it (the switches PERF.edsDraftModel / PERF.edsVerifyModel in src/lib/perf/switches.js, or GEMINI_SYNTHESIS_MODEL / GEMINI_VERIFY_MODEL in the environment, e.g. claude-haiku-5-5) and nothing else; if it fails, the models after it in the chain are tried. The key is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; I send it in a header, never in the address and never in the log. I do not ask for extended thinking (speed and cost), and the reply's text blocks are joined. Pure fetch: no SDK.

symbols.name: isClaudeModel
doc: True for a model name that belongs to Anthropic.

symbols.name: noTemperatureModels
doc: Models that answered "400 ... temperature": I do not ask them for one again in this process (some newer models fix it).

symbols.name: JSON_ONLY
symbols.sig: const JSON_ONLY = "\n\nReply with the JSON object only: no words before it, no words after it, no code fence."
doc: The JSON-only instruction. Claude has no "answer as JSON" switch here, so I say it in the system prompt (the engine's parsers read the first { to the last }).

symbols.name: claudeCall
symbols.sig: export async function claudeCall(model: string, prompt: string, req: GeminiRequest, timeoutMs: number): Promise<GeminiReply>

behaviours: names that belong to Anthropic are recognised, others are not
a claude model is sent to the Messages API, once, with the key in a header and the version header
the body carries the model, the token budget (twice the caller's: Claude counts more tokens), the temperature, the prompt as the user message
the system prompt is sent with the JSON-only instruction after it
the key is never in the address or the body
the reply is the joined text, the model that answered, and the usage in the shape the engine reads (prompt includes cached)
HTTP ${status} from Claude: the next model answers
no credit stops at once, with a message for the administrator
a refused key stops at once
a rejected temperature is retried without it
a cut-off answer is an error, never returned as if complete
without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY the chain moves on to the next model
GEMINI_SYNTHESIS_MODEL / GEMINI_VERIFY_MODEL = claude-haiku-5-5 make Claude the first model of the writer and of the checker, Gemini the fallbacks
the key is read only from the environment, and never printed by this module
